problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a real-valued C³ function; convexity is not required. The initial objective gap satisfies f(x₀)−inf f≤Δ.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Oracle 0 returns the exact pair (f(x),∇f(x)) at any queried point, independently of history and seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Exact function values are bundled with gradients in oracle 0; one bundled query counts as one call.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Oracle 1 returns the full exact Hessian as a continuous linear operator. Its calls have a separate fixed budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The third derivative is globally L₃-Lipschitz in operator norm, and ‖∇²f(x₀)‖≤H₀. All parameters, including E, x₀, L₃, Δ, H₀ and ε, are public; L₃,Δ,ε>0 and H₀≥0. No global gradient- or Hessian-Lipschitz bound is supplied.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a point x satisfying ‖∇f(x)‖≤ε; no objective-gap or second-order stationarity requirement is imposed on the output.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The gradient-norm criterion holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, with fixed per-oracle budgets.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: This is a standard smooth nonconvex first-order stationarity benchmark with Lipschitz third derivative and exact derivative information, with function/gradient and Hessian evaluations counted separately.

descriptionHtml:
Nonconvex Optimization with Lipschitz Third Derivatives

We consider minimizing a possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E. The function is three times continuously differentiable with L3-Lipschitz third derivative, where L3>0. A given point x0∈E satisfies f(x0)−infx∈Ef(x)≤Δ and ∥∇2f(x0)∥op≤H0, where Δ>0 and H0≥0; derivative norms are induced operator norms. Two exact oracles return (f(x),∇f(x)) and ∇2f(x), respectively. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E satisfying ∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is infx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The Hessian ∇2f(x) is a linear operator from E to E, and ∇3f(x) is the third derivative viewed as a trilinear form on E. The algorithm receives E, x0, L3, Δ, H0, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Third-derivative regularity). The function f belongs to C3(E;R), and ∥∇3f(x)−∇3f(y)∥op≤L3∥x−y∥,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Initial gap and curvature). The given point x0 satisfies f(x0)−f(x)≤Δfor every x∈E,∥∇2f(x0)∥op≤H0.

Both oracles accept queries at any point of E, and their calls are counted separately. After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy ∥∇f(x¯)∥≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, f∈C3 has L3-Lipschitz third derivative, f(x0)−inff≤Δ, and ∥∇2f(x0)∥≤H0, where L3,Δ,ε>0 and H0≥0. Exact value/gradient and full-Hessian oracles are available. The target is ∥∇f(xout)∥≤ε almost surely; (1) guarantees it for every seed. No global gradient- or Hessian-Lipschitz bound or algorithm restriction is imposed.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

namespace LongTails.Setups.ThirdDerivativeSmoothNonconvex

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  x0 : E
  L₃ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  H₀ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE

abbrev spec : Setup where
  numOracles := 2
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := (ℝ × p.E) ⊕ (p.E →L[ℝ] p.E)
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L₃ ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ p.H₀ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    ContDiff ℝ 3 f ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient f)) x -
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient f)) y‖ ≤ p.L₃ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, f p.x0 - f x ≤ p.Δ) ∧
    ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient f) p.x0‖ ≤ p.H₀ ∧
    (∀ k x seed, O.answer k (0, x) seed = Sum.inl (f x, gradient f x)) ∧
    (∀ k x seed, O.answer k (1, x) seed = Sum.inr (fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x))
  successful p f output P := ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : Measure _), ‖gradient f (output ω)‖ ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.ThirdDerivativeSmoothNonconvex
